field.name: country_id
field.label: COM_DECARODCL_FIELD_SCOPE_COUNTRY
field.query: SELECT id AS value, CONCAT(name, ' (', code, ')') AS text FROM #__decarocompetitions_countries WHERE state <> -2 ORDER BY name ASC

field.name: zone_ids
field.label: COM_DECARODCL_FIELD_SCOPE_ZONES
field.query: SELECT z.id AS value, CONCAT(z.name, IF(o.name IS NULL, '', CONCAT(' — ', o.name))) AS text FROM #__decarocompetitions_zones AS z LEFT JOIN #__decarocompetitions_organizations AS o ON o.id = z.organization_id WHERE z.state <> -2 ORDER BY z.ordering ASC, z.name ASC

field.name: organizer_ids
field.label: COM_DECARODCL_FIELD_ORGANIZER
field.query: SELECT id AS value, CONCAT(name, IF(short_name IS NULL OR short_name = '', '', CONCAT(' (', short_name, ')'))) AS text FROM #__decarocompetitions_organizations WHERE state <> -2 ORDER BY ordering ASC, name ASC

field.name: governing_body_ids
field.label: COM_DECARODCL_FIELD_GOVERNING_BODY
field.query: SELECT id AS value, CONCAT(name, IF(short_name IS NULL OR short_name = '', '', CONCAT(' (', short_name, ')'))) AS text FROM #__decarocompetitions_organizations WHERE state <> -2 ORDER BY ordering ASC, name ASC
